races.name: Happy 96th Birthday John Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
SPARTAN TIMES is still unexposed as a hurdler and looks well-in based on his recent Flat exploits, so he makes plenty of appeal. Jolie Coeur Allen wasn't beaten far over C&D on his most recent outing and should go well again with Charlie Maggs a positive jockey booking. Recent winner Cawthorne Cracker is also respected.

  1. SPARTAN TIMES
  2. JOLIE COEUR ALLEN (FR)
  3. CAWTHORNE CRACKER (IRE)

races.name: Roxyfet Sports Lounge For Private Hire Juvenile Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
STEEL RAVEN has been progressing well since upped to 1¼m+ on the Flat and appeals as the type to take well to hurdling. He's preferred to Jerseygeordie, who made much more impact tried over hurdles than in a handful of starts on all-weather for Jamie Osborne when third at Newton Abbot last month, form which has already been franked by the first 2. Watcha Snoop may prove best of the rest.

  1. STEEL RAVEN (IRE)
  2. JERSEYGEORDIE
  3. WATCHA SNOOP (IRE)

races.name: Paxtons No1 CaseIH Dealer Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
TANKING ALONG was let down by his jumping at Cartmel last time, but he'd been in notably in good form prior to that, so is well worth another chance for an in-form stable. Passengerontheship is narrowly preferred to Thank You Blue for forecast purposes.

  1. TANKING ALONG (IRE)
  2. PASSENGERONTHESHIP (IRE)
  3. THANK YOU BLUE

races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse For Outdoor Events Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
HIJO DE LA LUNA's recent form looks sound and he's taken to notch a breakthrough win over hurdles. Whitewinewednesday had excuses on her first start for her all-conquering yard at Limerick in May and remains one to keep an eye on given her previous promise, while Vanilla Dancer is the type to bounce back quickly from a below-par display when last seen.

  1. HIJO DE LA LUNA (GER)
  2. WHITEWINEWEDNESDAY (IRE)
  3. VANILLA DANCER

races.name: Premier Road Markings Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JET OF DREAMS quite possibly needed the run after a 4-month break at Uttoxeter recently and having been given a chance by the handicapper, is a tentative selection to repeat his win in this race last year. Mary gives the impression she'll benefit from this return to shorter and is feared most.

  1. JET OF DREAMS (IRE)
  2. MARY (IRE)
  3. DREAM DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: Fairlight Studios Cafe At Sedgefield Racecourse Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CLOSE HOUSE showed plenty in what is usually a warm race at Ayr back in the spring and is a straightforward choice to get off the mark at the second time of asking. Red Shea was no match for a useful prospect at Cork last month but kept on to pull clear of the remainder and should at least give the selection something to think about if coping with the sharper test. Lower De Couely, an easy winner on her sole outing in Irish points, shouldn't be overlooked in the betting, either.

  1. CLOSE HOUSE (IRE)
  2. RED SHEA (IRE)
  3. LOWER DE COUELY (FR)

races.name: Christmas Party Day Dancing At Ayr Racecourse Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
Sole 3-y-o LEOPARDS ROCK can trump his much more exposed rivals with a return to further likely to bring more improvement. Empirestateofmind was only just denied the follow up at Hamilton 9 days ago so is feared most ahead of Arkenstaar, who arrives fresh after a light campaign.

  1. LEOPARDS ROCK
  2. EMPIRESTATEOFMIND (IRE)
  3. ARKENSTAAR

races.name: Weddings At Western House Hotel Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The drop back in trip should suit LUNA LACY, who was too free when a promising fifth at Musselburgh earlier this month. She gets the nod. What A Girl Wants has proven expensive to follow but looks the obvious danger nonetheless.

  1. LUNA LACY (IRE)
  2. WHAT A GIRL WANTS (IRE)
  3. NAVAL ARCHITECT (IRE)

races.name: Nairns's Oatcakes Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Plenty to consider but KEEP AN EYE ON IT was unlucky not to beat his elders at Carlisle 6 weeks ago and can make amends with trip/ground unlikely to be an issue. Star Cast, Kokanee and Mehmas Champion all rate serious threats.

  1. KEEP AN EYE ON IT
  2. STAR CAST
  3. KOKANEE (IRE)

races.name: Autumn Breaks At Western House Hotel Handicap
races.verdict:
The in-form HOMESTRAIT ran a cracker in a stronger contest at Chester last time and can race off the same mark here. She makes fair appeal. Misunderstood and One NIght Thunder rate the principal dangers.

  1. HOMESTRAIT (IRE)
  2. MISUNDERSTOOD (FR)
  3. ONE NIGHT THUNDER

races.name: Book Your Event At Ayr Racecourse Handicap
races.verdict:
HIGHFIELD VIKING bounced back to form when third over C&D 12 days ago and he's well treated if building on that with conditions in his favour once again. Showtown is another who revived last time and is next best ahead of fellow 3-y-o Lope Y Linda.

  1. HIGHFIELD VIKING
  2. SHOWTOWN (IRE)
  3. LOPE Y LINDA

races.name: Book Racing On Saturday 31 October Handicap
races.verdict:
Course winner ASHEN was clear of the rest when a good second at Hamilton last week and should appreciate the return to this longer trip. He gets the nod. Recent Hamilton scorer Belsito is feared most, whilst market strength behind the lightly-raced Big Harry again could prove significant.

  1. ASHEN (IRE)
  2. BELSITO (GER)
  3. BIG HARRY

races.name: Racing TV Handicap
races.verdict:
Last year's winner AIGHEAR tends to save her best for this time of year and signalled a return to form at Hamilton earlier this month. She is fancied to land the finale. Time Turner and Furhaan should also go well.

  1. AIGHEAR
  2. TIME TURNER
  3. FURHAAN

races.name: Hotel & Conferencing At Wolverhampton Handicap
races.verdict:
The draw could have been kinder to HENFIELD but she caught the eye with her strong finish at Lingfield last time and gets the nod ahead of Manton Road, another who shaped well from too far back on his latest start. It's A Love Thing can also play a part if able to back up his latest Newcastle third.

  1. HENFIELD
  2. MANTON ROAD
  3. IT'S A LOVE THING

races.name: Free Race Replays On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
SEVENKINGSMUSTDIE is taken to build on his promising C&D handicap debut third and prove too strong for last week's Kempton scorer Arundel.

  1. SEVENKINGSMUSTDIE (IRE)
  2. ARUNDEL (IRE)
  3. GOLSPIE (IRE)

races.name: attheraces.com/marketmovers Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ARABIAN SUMMER made her debut in quite a useful contest at Kempton a couple of years ago. It's taken a long time to get her back but plenty from this stable have overcome long absences down the years and she gets the vote with confidence in her chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Battlefield Boy shaped with encouragement on his recent debut and is feared most ahead of Gold Star Gazing. The selection's debuting stablemate Soft Landing needs monitoring in the betting.

  1. ARABIAN SUMMER (IRE)
  2. BATTLEFIELD BOY (FR)
  3. GOLD STAR GAZING (IRE)

races.name: Free Tips On attheraces.com Handicap
races.verdict:
DISTILLATION took his C&D form figures to 2121 when making all with ease last Monday and should be tough to beat under a 6 lb-penalty. Dark Mandate has made a positive start for new trainer Eve Johnson Houghton and is the obvious danger. Deadline is next on the list.

  1. DISTILLATION (FR)
  2. DARK MANDATE
  3. DEADLINE (FR)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Virgin 512 EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
George Boughey's OXBRIDGE doesn't have a high standard to aim at on debut and gets the vote, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Urumita was a bit disappointing at Windsor but is sure to go well if bouncing back to the level of her Newbury debut.

  1. OXBRIDGE (IRE)
  2. URUMITA (IRE)
  3. NIGHTBLOOM (IRE)

races.name: Race & Rest - Wolverhampton Holiday Inn Handicap
races.verdict:
METHGAL advanced his form significantly when making all at Kempton last week and a 5-lb penalty may not be enough to prevent the follow up here. Rye and Cosmic Clarets head the list of dangers.

  1. METHGAL (IRE)
  2. RYE
  3. COSMIC CLARETS (IRE)

races.name: Follow AtTheRaces On Instagram Handicap
races.verdict:
D DAY MAJOR WINTER hasn't been with James Owen long and took another step back in the right direction when runner-up here a fortnight ago. He can land the spoils. Notable Charm and Echo Valley are also of interest.

  1. D DAY MAJOR WINTER
  2. NOTABLE CHARM
  3. ECHO VALLEY

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
This can go to EQUION, who took advantage of a much-reduced mark when getting back to winning ways at Ffos Las last week and still look fairly treated, despite a 4-lb penalty. Kev and Tortola can also make their presence felt.

  1. EQUION
  2. KEV
  3. TORTOLA (IRE)

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
DUMFRIES has been cut plenty of slack by the handicapper and shaped much better than the bare result at Beverley last time. He makes plenty of appeal. Book Of Life and Nicely Curved may prove the chief threats.

  1. DUMFRIES
  2. BOOK OF LIFE
  3. NICELY CURVED (USA)

races.name: JDL Consultants Ltd Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
DECALOGUE was value for a good deal extra when off the mark at Kempton 2 weeks ago so a 3 lb rise may not be enough to prevent the follow up. Oman is now 2 lb lower than for his Goodwood win in June when refitted in this headgear, so is next best ahead of Pangbourne.

  1. DECALOGUE (USA)
  2. OMAN (IRE)
  3. PANGBOURNE

races.name: MJ Church Handicap
races.verdict:
HEBRIDEAN NOMAD wasn't beaten far despite setting a strong pace at Lingfield last time so gets the vote in what looks a lesser race. Unexposed 3-y-os Zarco and Cosmo Brown are feared most.

  1. HEBRIDEAN NOMAD
  2. ZARCO
  3. COSMO BROWN (IRE)

races.name: AEL Solutions Handicap
races.verdict:
BUCKLAND BELLE can land the fourth win of a very productive season. Rating has a solid C&D record and heads the dangers along with Amarachi and Chilly Breeze.

  1. BUCKLAND BELLE
  2. RATING (IRE)
  3. AMARACHI (IRE)

races.name: British EBF Future Stayers' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
DIVIDE AND CONQUER went close to landing a gamble at Ascot on debut so is preferred to Al Qayed, who looks more of a 3-y-o prospect.

  1. DIVIDE AND CONQUER (IRE)
  2. AL QAYED (IRE)
  3. POLITICAL RESIDENT

races.name: SW Hire Handicap
races.verdict:
SOUTH SHORE continues to thrive for his current yard and his latest win at Sandown looks rock solid given what the re-opposing Maharajas Express has since achieved. Brave Nation completes the shortlist having made a bright start for Michael Attwater.

  1. SOUTH SHORE
  2. MAHARAJAS EXPRESS
  3. BRAVE NATION (IRE)

races.name: Power Logistics Nursery
races.verdict:
HEMUSTBEANANGEL shaped quite well on his 7f nursery debut and can come good back over shorter for in-form Roger Teal. Devon Angel has been runner-up on her last 2 starts and rates an obvious danger. Snow On The Beach is with an excellent stable and rates a potential improver in her first handicap.

  1. HEMUSTBEANANGEL (IRE)
  2. DEVON ANGEL
  3. SNOW ON THE BEACH

races.name: Clyde And Co Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
DISTANT RUMBLE had plenty to spare at Windsor and is selected to make light of a 7 lb rise, perhaps at the expense of the thriving Legendsoftheland. Rumble Ruby and Control Room are others capable of having a say.

  1. DISTANT RUMBLE
  2. LEGENDSOFTHELAND (IRE)
  3. RUMBLE RUBY

races.name: Clyde And Co Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Three-time C&D winner MOE'S LEGACY could be ready to strike off a winning mark, especially if the rain stays away. Charlie Boyo is well worth another chance so is second choice ahead of fellow 3-y-o Guilty Verdict, whose Salisbury form has worked out very well.

  1. MOE'S LEGACY
  2. CHARLIE BOYO (IRE)
  3. GUILTY VERDICT

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
races.verdict:
Not a strong maiden and it would be no surprise to see BOLD COMMANDER leave behind a couple of lesser efforts and get off the mark now fitted with blinkers. Sonny Hayes is an interesting newcomer, while Sapphire Sun could do better if settling down.

  1. BOLD COMMANDER (IRE)
  2. SONNY HAYES (IRE)
  3. SAPPHIRE SUN (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Nursery Handicap (Birdcatcher Series)
races.verdict:
There is more to come from PINK VENOM after last week's Fairyhouse success and she can defy a 9 lb rise. Howlin Wolf continues to improve and looks the danger in new headgear.

  1. PINK VENOM (IRE)
  2. HOWLIN WOLF (IRE)
  3. CAPTAIN JAMES COOK

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict:
BY THE LAKE is taken to build on her promising handicap/stable debut last month and strike under Colin Keane. Flash of Fire made a positive start for the Johnny Murtagh stable when fourth at Punchestown a fortnight ago and is taken to build on that and provide the chief threat ahead of Staysound Susie, who won this in 2024 and would be very much at home should the ground go soft/heavy.

  1. BY THE LAKE (IRE)
  2. FLASH OF FIRE
  3. STAYSOUND SUSIE (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
VERIFIED has gone close off higher marks, including at this track, and is chanced in the hope it can all come together back from a break in refitted headgear. El Fontenaro, Simmering Seas and last year's winner Ukiyo are all in the picture too.

  1. VERIFIED (IRE)
  2. EL FONTENARO (IRE)
  3. SIMMERING SEAS (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Navigation Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
SUMMER IS TOMORROW has improved since a visor went on and looks well worth another shot at this level. Shaihaan is feared most back down in class, while Latin America is the potential improver in the field.

  1. SUMMER IS TOMORROW (IRE)
  2. SHAIHAAN (IRE)
  3. LATIN AMERICA (IRE)

races.name: Irish EBF Fillies Maiden (Smullen Series)
races.verdict:
This has the makings of a really interesting maiden with GOLDEN RING taken to make her experience count and get off the mark, this step up to 1m promising to unlock further improvement. Gods Love, Duchessofaquitaine and Somebody Loves Me, a stablemate of the selection, head up a host of appealing newcomers.

  1. GOLDEN RING (IRE)
  2. GODS LOVE
  3. DUCHESSOFAQUITAINE (IRE)

races.name: Follow Us On X Handicap
races.verdict:
PLAYIN COOL has contested some warm handicaps this year and shaped encouragingly in the Irish Cambridgeshire last month. With his sights lowered after a 3 lb drop in the weights he could be set to play a prominent role. Karrygrant and Daler are big dangers.

  1. PLAYIN COOL (IRE)
  2. KARRYGRANT (IRE)
  3. DALER (IRE)

races.name: Fitzgerald's Woodlands House Hotel Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
CAUSE I LIKE YOU has run well over this trip since scoring at Killarney in July and gets the nod in an open-looking finale. Medieval Night and Monocle Rocket head the list of dangers.

  1. CAUSE I LIKE YOU (IRE)
  2. MEDIEVAL NIGHT (IRE)
  3. MONOCLE ROCKET (IRE)

races.name: Prix Hotel Barriere Le Royal Deauville Stakes
Prix Du Syndicat Des Eleveurs Du Sud-est Handicap
Prix De L'union Hippique De La Mediterranee Handicap
Prix De La Chambre Du Duc Handicap
Prix Du Salon Des Conde Handicap
Prix Du Salon De Guise Handicap
Prix De La Troublerie Maiden Stakes
